designwk.label: satisfied

variety.label: satisfied

placemen.label: yes

money.label: agree

jobdecid.label: Strongly agree

jobdecid.reasoning: Wants placement to help decide what to do after university.

industry.label: Strongly agree
industry.evidence: you get to like see how design works in industry, like it’s completely different to designing on a course

perdevel.label: agree
perdevel.evidence: I think like that way you can like more organised within yourself, making sure you do things
perdevel.reasoning: Expects placement to develop independence/organisation; personal development.

jobprosp.label: agree

jobprosp.reasoning: Values a year of experience for future job prospects.

breaked.label: agree

breaked.reasoning: Worries about losing skills and forgetting things after the placement break.

placloca.label: agree
placloca.evidence: I didn’t really want to go for a placement and have to live somewhere by myself

noappeal.label: agree
noappeal.evidence: most of them I’m not interested in and they’re like really far away or really technical
noappeal.reasoning: Many advertised placements did not appeal (too technical/far away).

carpath.label: design work
carpath.evidence: I’m interested in design things but not – I don’t want to be like really technical and in just like industrial things. So it’s more like a broad range of design
carpath.reasoning: Wants a future in (creative) design work, not technical/manufacturing.

salary.label: neither important nor unimportant
salary.evidence: I haven’t worried too much about pay – I haven’t looked for a high salary and just aimed for those, I haven’t looked at that too much
salary.reasoning: Pay not a priority in choosing a placement; salary low-importance/neutral.

location.label: important
location.evidence: when I’m looking for placements now, they’re definitely around [university area], like where I can commute to. So I’ve restricted myself to that.
location.reasoning: Location strongly shaped her placement search; important.

workenv.label: important
workenv.evidence: just the ones that say like quite creative, and almost like quite relaxed (yeah). Not really very formal
workenv.reasoning: Drawn to relaxed, creative, informal work environments; environment matters.

highsal.label: disagree
highsal.evidence: I haven’t looked for a high salary and just aimed for those
highsal.reasoning: Not driven by high salary; disagrees salary drew her to the field.
